summary: Implement Idempotency and Deduplication for Settlement API
description:
Implement idempotency verification on /v1/settlements to prevent double charges.

h3. Acceptance Criteria
- [x] Validate presence of Idempotency-Key header on POST /v1/settlements
- [ ] Return HTTP 409 Conflict with error code IDEMPOTENCY_CONCURRENT_REQUEST if concurrent
- [x] Cache successful response payload for 24 hours and set X-Cache: HIT

h3. Additional Requirements
- Support export of settlement ledger to Excel spreadsheet format (.xlsx)
